name: Kyou no Nippeke
source:
At Orinae Academy, where various races come together,
There exists a special class where students are permitted to form relationships with an eye toward the future—what is commonly known as “marriage hunting” and “baby-making.”
That class is 2-X.
What awaited the protagonist, who transferred in on a whim, was a journey of marriage hunting and baby-making alongside heroines whose values and instincts were completely different from his own.
Each race has its own distinct feelings and goals.
Even so, they approach him with remarkable sincerity, closing the distance between them.
Every day is lively, unpredictable, and just a little out of the ordinary.
Before he knows it, his life is no longer just an ordinary school life.
Love? The future? —Or perhaps both?

In this place where instinct takes precedence over reason—even if only slightly—the story unfolds.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/114kyouno2x/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
在汇聚了形形色色种族的奥利纳埃学园里，
设立着一个允许学生以未来为前提交往互动——也就是俗称开展“相亲求偶”与“造人备孕”——的特别班级。
那个班级正是“2-X”。
等待着一时兴起转入该班的男主角的，是与一群价值观及种族本能都和自己截然不同的美少女们共同展开的相亲与造人生活。
每一个种族都怀揣着各自独特的情感与目标。
即便如此，少女们依然无比真挚地主动向他靠近，一步步拉近彼此的距离。
每一天都热闹欢腾、出人意料，又带着几分非同寻常的刺激。
不知不觉间，他的日常早已不再只是普通的校园生活。
是爱情？是未来？——又或者两者兼得？

在这个本能稍稍凌驾于理性之上的地方，故事正式拉开帷幕。

[译自[url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/114kyouno2x/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
